releases.title: Echoes Of Summer EP
releases.about: Originally from the South Coast of England, Brad lived some years in Melbourne, Australia, and now he is based again in England. He is a DJ and producer driven by curiosity, freedom and a deep connection to underground electronic music. Unbound by genre, Brad moves naturally between off-kilter house, techno, breaks, electro and darker, more unexpected corners of the spectrum, like this new EP on our label. Go get your copy!

releases.title: Break 3000 - Discothèque (Guterres Edit) (Free Download)
releases.about: Hi, everyone! We are here to thank you so much for all these years supporting us and as a gift, for this Bandcamp Friday, we are giving away this edit of Guterres, our resident. Hope you like it and also our entire discography is now with a 70% discount until Friday of next week. See you soon :)

releases.title: House Of Corner EP
releases.about: The georgian Yamoc returns to our sonar series with another party EP, but this time he invited his countryman Mocongo for a breakbeat reinterpretation and the result is fantastic. It's out now =)

releases.title: Waverider EP
releases.about: Hi, everyone. On this opportunity, we welcome an established Portuguese producer: Rowan. A great connection between melodic textures and an astral trip. The EP counts with a break remix of Existencia Pasajera, another excellent producer and very well known in this scene. Super EP!

releases.title: Prog Dialog EP
tracks: Yapp! - Prog Dialog (Glen S' Robot Sound Remix)
releases.about: Hi everyone! EP number 8 on our Sonar series is ready to go and in this occasion we introduce you to the world of Yapp! Young but experienced producer from Israel, he blends House, trance and progressive in a futuristic way. It's perfect for heating up any stage. The reinterpretation comes from Glen S, Australian based in Berlin, with a percussive version and a robotic voice, perfect for an intro.

releases.title: Fabio On Time EP
releases.about: Hello, Kematikers! After a long period without a full EP release, we have a very good reason to show up again. This EP has 4 original tracks, from a nice guy and an excellent producer from Slovenia. Fabricio is one of a kind between the new comers on underground electronic music. His talent is remarkable and this EP proves it. Each track has it's own moment for listening or playing, and they can be used in many ways at parties or even listening at home, work, whatever. A blend of house, electro, funk, and vision. Just give it a try!

releases.title: KMY016
releases.about: Hi, fans! Here we go again and this time we come with our first ever album released, and it couldn't be different, it's from our resident and collaborator, Tasq. He is one of a kind with his deep minimalistic world of possibilities. Just an incredible journey into his brand new works. Go try it!

releases.title: One-Off (Free Download)
releases.about: An Easter gift for all you fans. Made by our resident, Guterres. Thanks for all.

releases.title: Electric Energy EP
releases.about: In the next chapter, we present again Yamoc, a georgian artist that brings a good mix of house, tech, trance and progressive characteristcs in his music. The EP has 5 tracks, all of them are a heat for the crowd and the last one is a ambient/downtempo, great for starting a set. Please, go check it s2

releases.title: Where Is The Groove EP
releases.about: For our release of number 5 in this series, we welcome OT, an egyptian that is showing really good skills with his deep vision sound design. This EP is pretty interesting. A four track that little by little evolve you and proves why he is a rising star. Wish you a good ride <3

releases.title: Orbital Frequency EP
releases.about: Returning now with our fourth release on Kematiky Sonar Episodes, a strong EP made by a super talented britanic producer, Jonny Wednesday. Here we got 4 dancefloor rockets to fit well your cases. Let's go :D

releases.title: Turbo Beats VA
releases.about: The third episode is a various artists, this is the fourth and last part of 4 parts and each one has a different theme, showing all genres we like the most. Last piece here, we present you with 4 house tracks, designed to give spice to the dancefloor, with some progressive and trance elements. 2 tracks from brazilians, one from Guterres, our gold boy resident, another from a new comer in the label, Truecall. Other 2 tracks are from UK and Georgia. Hannd, which already released a great ep with us and the debut of Yamoc. Now we close this VA with 16 tracks. Great to have in your cases.

releases.title: Concrete Vision VA
tracks: Ranura De La Selva - Building Blocks
Terrenza - It Ain’t Too Goddamn Beaucoup
releases.about: The third episode is a various artists, this is the third part of 4 parts and each part has a different theme, showing all genres we like the most. This chapter gives us 4 solid and smooth tracks and the meaning is on the name of it, which resumes them: Concrete Vision. We have here 2 brazilians and 2 europeans, one from France and another from UK. Such great talents right here. Be aware, contains beauty and concept =D

releases.title: Dark Is Relative VA
releases.about: The third episode is a various artists, this is the second part of 4 parts and each part has a different theme, showing all genres we like the most. On this one, we have 4 techno house tracks, with more obscure elements. One is from the brazilian rising talent PR.A.DO and 3 from producers all over the world: Portugal, Slovenia and Egypt. Very energetic here! =)

releases.about: The third episode is a various artists, this first part of 4 parts and each part has a different theme, showing all genres we like the most. On this one, we have 4 house party tracks, 2 from brazilians and 2 from british producers. have a nice shot, buddies!

releases.title: The Future Dance EP
releases.about: Continuing our new sonar series, our boy Guterres comes at his best in this moment, with a beautiful journey into his new spacy music aesthetic. Each track has it's own mood, all of them to kill any dancefloor around the world. The remixer this time is a well known producer from Uruguay: Marcos Coya. Make sure you don't miss this super EP.

releases.title: KMY015
releases.about: Hello everyone. Next chapter is a VA of two artists: one is the Romanian great talent, Boncalo Denis and the other is one of our local pupils, Zippel and his incredible plural way of producing. They show their potential in 4 deep minimal pieces, 2 for each artist.

releases.title: KMY014
tracks: Caiot - Free to Create (Mat Roz Remix)
releases.about: Yo friends! This EP is a 3 tracker from a Brazilian artist and friend of the label for a long time: Caiot, Sintoniza Records creator. It comes with a deep interpretation of an emerging new talent from São Paulo, Mat Roz. He runs a nice label called Loup Soup Records which has lots of strong tracks and much more to come.

releases.title: KMY013
releases.about: We present our release number 13 with a new comer from Costa Rica, Briggs. He invites another producer (Ranbe) to make a great remix aswell. This EP consists in 3 bomb minimal deep tech tracks. Let's check!

releases.title: Light After Dark EP
tracks: Kawaii San - Love Across a Crowded Rave
releases.about: Hi, fellas! We had a pause for a while for a good cause: to evolve and prepare ourselves to this release, that represents the beginning of a new era in our music. We are constantly changing and seeking for new forms to express the vibrations that we like the most and it was already time to start a new series in our label, which is more focused on House/Electro/Techno/Breaks party weapons and it's called: Kematiky Sonar Episodes. Our debut artist on this is someone we follow for a long time, who is producing a lot of great tracks lately: Kawaii San. His deep sound design is such an inspiration to the more demanding listeners. This EP is a real trip between spacey elements and solid grooves. 5 beautiful tracks that will make you enjoy yourselves.

releases.title: KMY012.2
releases.about: After a long break, we are back with the second part for the previous release, from our hood boy, Tasq. 4 minimal, dub and house beautiful tracks that takes you into a journey which defines his particular style so well. Go for it!
